name: Diff view
description: Codex 风格的本地差异审查：Git 范围、轮次快照、逐行反馈和有冲突保护的暂存/撤销。
author: new-Beginner
safetyNotes: 可信本地插件：agent.extension 在 Agent 进程运行、renderer.extension 在宿主界面运行，都没有 OS 沙箱。快照、Git 索引暂存和撤销使用插件内的 Node/Git 适配器，不受宿主 fs 网关逐次约束。插件自行限制在授权项目根/已绑定采集根内，拒绝凭据路径、.. 和符号链接逃逸。恢复先校验内容指纹、保留恢复副本并要求确认。无网络、模型调用、自动发送、提交或推送；历史与评论存放插件私有目录。Agent/main 桥接只在用户目录 .pi-diff-view/locators 写入本插件实例定位信息，不读取宿主数据库。

en.description: Codex-style local change review: Git scopes, captured turns, inline feedback, staging and conflict-protected restore.
en.safetyNotes: Trusted unsandboxed Agent and renderer extensions. Node/Git adapters perform snapshots, index writes and guarded restores outside the host fs gateway. Project-root containment, credential/symlink rejection, content checks, backups and user confirmation are enforced by this plugin. No network, paid model calls, auto-send, commit or push. Private history plus a plugin-only locator under ~/.pi-diff-view. No host database access.
